result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers pick B and give sound reasons for rejecting A and C: unreadably small or huge text, ignored zoom and font settings, abrupt breakpoint jumps and no line-length cap. Both get the clamp ramp wrong. It actually runs from 16px at 320px wide to 20px at about 1320px, but A says roughly 400px to 1050px and B says about 19px at 800px (really about 18px) and 20px from 1000px (really about 18.7px). B adds a useful note that 68ch grows with the font size and suggests an em breakpoint, while A adds a few short extra tips, so overall they are about equal. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers pick B and give the right reasons for rejecting A and C. Both also get some clamp numbers wrong. The ceiling actually arrives at about 1320px wide, and the size at 800px is about 18px. Answer A at least gets the 320px floor right, while Answer B gets both of its breakpoint figures wrong. Answer A's caveat about ch scaling with font size is accurate and relevant. Answer B's extra 'small tweaks' section goes a little beyond the question, though it does helpfully cite WCAG 1.4.4.
